concerns.text: The plan states that effect sizes will be reported as "Pearson’s r (derived from Spearman rho)". Pearson’s r and Spearman’s rho are distinct statistics; Pearson’s r cannot be mathematically derived from Spearman’s rho without access to the original raw data. This creates a circular/tautological validation because the reported Pearson r would be a deterministic transformation of the already‑computed Spearman rho, not an independent estimate of linear association. The methodology should either (a) compute Pearson’s r directly on the raw (or appropriately transformed) data, or (b) report Spearman’s rho as the effect size without attempting to convert it.
